n: 4K60 multi-layer video mixer and seamless presentation switcher (Pulse 4K)
d: 4K60 multi-layer video mixer and seamless presentation switcher, with ten inputs, two PGM outputs and one dedicated Multiviewer

specs.label: Outputs
specs.value: 2x HDMI 2.0 connectors + 2x mirrored 12G/6G/3G-SDI connectors, up to 4K60

specs.label: Output modes
specs.value: Matrix (2 independent PGM) or Switcher (1 PGM + 1 AUX)

specs.label: Livestreaming
specs.value: RTMP, up to 1080p30, H.264 video and AAC audio

specs.label: HDR
specs.value: HDR10 and HLG, built-in SDR/HDR converters
